snippet.title: King of Meat: Out Now
snippet.description:
Unleash your ridiculous now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

Become a fearless Contender as you battle through and build devious dungeons for gory, gory glory. King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against unpredictable traps, quirky puzzles, and whacky monsters. Your road to glory awaits.
Learn more at https://bit.ly/4fDegtC
